Class TypstText

java.lang.Object
network.ike.docs.typst.TypstText
public final class TypstText extends Object
Text-level Typst serialization: escaping for markup mode, string literals, labels, and the protected-span convention that lets already-emitted Typst travel through a text pass untouched.

Asciidoctor hands a converter substituted text: plain text with HTML special characters entity-escaped (&lt;, &#8212;), and the output of earlier inline conversions spliced in. Those earlier outputs are finished Typst and must not be escaped again, so every inline conversion wraps its result in protect(String); markup(String) then decodes and escapes only the text between protected spans.

This class is the seed of the shared Typst writer library (design topic dev-document-surface-pages, "One shared Typst writer library"): the same escaping rules serve the AsciiDoc converter and Komet's block-model writer.

  • Method Details

    • protect

      public static String protect(String typst)
      Wraps finished Typst so that the substitutions Asciidoctor still runs on the surrounding text (macros, replacements, post-replacements) never see it, and a later markup(String) or plain(String) pass restores it verbatim. The span is Base64 between two control characters, inside angle brackets: Base64 holds none of the characters those substitutions key on, so a ] in a content block cannot end a footnote macro early and an apostrophe in a string literal cannot become a curly quote; and the angle brackets make the span look like an HTML tag, which Asciidoctor strips when it derives a section id from the converted title, so == Using *bold* still gets the id _using_bold. (A real < in text is &lt; by then.)
      Parameters:
      typst - finished Typst source
      Returns:
      the opaque span

    • wrap

      public static String wrap(String open, String text, String close)
      Wraps substituted text in an opening and a closing piece of Typst, each protected on its own, leaving the text in place for the enclosing text pass to decode and escape. Used for every inline construct whose content is markup (#strong[…], #footnote[…]), so that Asciidoctor still sees the words when it derives ids from a title.
      Parameters:
      open - the Typst before the text, ending with [
      text - substituted text, left as is
      close - the Typst after the text
      Returns:
      the wrapped text

    • markup

      public static String markup(String substituted)
      Turns Asciidoctor-substituted text into Typst markup: decodes HTML entities and escapes markup-significant characters outside protected spans, and restores protected spans verbatim. After a protected span a ; terminates the embedded expression when the following character would otherwise continue it.
      Parameters:
      substituted - text as Asciidoctor delivers it, possibly null
      Returns:
      Typst markup
